senses.gloss: ch. same, to press, crowd; to gather.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 41:7">Targ. Ps. XLI, 7</cite> (v. <cite ref="K00861"><he>כְּנַס</he></cite>).—
<cite ref="Taanit 23b">Taan. 23ᵇ</cite> <he>ניתי לִיכְנוֹף גבי הדדי</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>נִיכְּנִיף הדדי</he>) let us go and crowd together (for prayer).
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 19b:9">Ab. Zar. 19ᵇ</cite> <he>כָּנוּף ואתי וכ׳</he> all the world crowded about him.—Part. pass. <cite ref="K00872"><he>כְּנִיף</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 29b:13">Snh. 29ᵇ</cite> <he>כְּנִיפֵי ויתבי</he> if they (before whom he made the admission, v. <cite ref="A00566"><he>אוֹדִיתָא</he></cite>) were assembled (for some other business), opp. to <he>כּנּפִינְהוּ איהו</he> if he himself called them to a meeting.
<cite ref="Shabbat 73b:4">Sabb. 73ᵇ</cite> <he>האי מאן דכ׳ וכ׳</he> he who grabs (skims with his palm) salt out of the salina.
<cite ref="Beitzah 33b">Bets. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>מחזי כמאן דמְכַנֵּיף וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>מכניא</he>, corr. acc.) it looks as though he raked together for the next day.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 1:1">Targ. Y. I Deut. I, 1</cite>.—Snh. l. c., v. supra.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 113a">B. Kam. 113ᵃ</cite> <he>לדידכו כַּנְּפִינְהוּ</he> Ms. M. (ed. v. <cite ref="K00845"><he>כְּנוּפְיָא</he></cite>) have we assembled them for your individual benefit?—Part. pass. <he>מְכַנַּף</he>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 58b:14">Ber. 58ᵇ</cite> <he>כמאה … דמְכַנְּפֵי</he> like one hundred stars … collected in one spot, opp. <he>מבדרי</he>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 147a:8">Sabb. 147ᵃ</cite> <he>אדעתא דלכַנּוּפֵי</he> with the intention of creasing.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 8:7">Targ. Cant. VIII, 7</cite>.—
